implemented_capabilities: Maven Spring Boot backend under backend/ using Java 17, Spring Web, Bean Validation, Spring Data JPA, H2, and Spring Boot tests.
Layered packages for controller, service, repository, domain, dto, exception, and validation.
Shared ApiException, ErrorCode, ApiErrorResponse, GlobalExceptionHandler, ValidationUtils, and PageRequestFactory reused across API and service boundaries.
Supplier create, edit, detail, and paginated search with uniqueness, length, phone, and status validation.
Product category create, edit, detail, and paginated search with uniqueness and status validation.
Product create, edit, detail, and paginated search with category validation, unique code validation, active-category rule, and product field constraints.
Purchase inbound create, edit, detail, and paginated search. Purchase totals are calculated server-side and purchase edit replaces related stock movements transactionally.
Sales outbound create, edit, detail, and paginated search. Sales totals are calculated server-side, sales edit replaces related stock movements transactionally, and insufficient stock is rejected.
Inventory query APIs for paginated product stock, single product current stock, and paginated stock movement ledger.
Slow-moving product report derived from product inventory and sales movements, including products with positive stock and no sales history.
Inventory is calculated from StockMovement ledger aggregation; purchase writes positive movements and sales writes negative movements.
